docs.text: 正在加载数据... 刷新数据 图像ID 检测结果 置信度 上报时间 const OBS_URL = "https://iotda-camera-data.obs.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/camera_data"; const statusEl = document.getElementById("status"); const tableBody = document.getElementById("tableBody"); const refreshBtn = document.getElementById("refreshBtn"); const chartContainer = document.getElementById("chartContainer"); let myChart = null; // 初始化图表 function initChart() { if (myChart) myChart.dispose(); myChart = echarts.init(chartContainer); } // 解析 OBS 数据（每行一个 JSON 对象） function parseData(text) { const lines = text.trim().split("\n"); return lines.map(line => JSON.parse(line)); } // 渲染表格 function renderTable(data) { tableBody.innerHTML = ""; data.forEach(item => { const props = item.notify_data.body.services[0].properties; const row = ` ${props.image_id} ${props.detect_result} ${props.detect_value} ${props.report_time} `; tableBody.innerHTML += row; }); } // 渲染 ECharts 折线图（展示置信度随时间变化） function renderChart(data) { const xData = data.map(item => item.notify_data.body.services[0].properties.report_time); const yData = data.map(item => parseFloat(item.notify_data.body.services[0].properties.detect_value)); const option = { title: { text: '共享单车检测置信度趋势' }, xAxis: { type: 'category', data: xData }, yAxis: { type: 'value', min: 0, max: 1 }, tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' }, series: [{ name: '置信度', type: 'line', data: yData, smooth: true }] }; myChart.setOption(option); } // 拉取并展示数据 async function fetchData() { try { statusEl.textContent = "正在加载数据..."; statusEl.style.color = "orange"; const res = await fetch(OBS_URL); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); const text = await res.text(); const data = parseData(text); renderTable(data); renderChart(data); statusEl.textContent = `加载成功，共 ${data.length} 条数据`; statusEl.style.color = "green"; } catch (err) { statusEl.textContent = `加载失败: ${err.message}`; statusEl.style.color = "red"; console.error(err); } } // 绑定刷新按钮 refreshBtn.addEventListener("click", fetchData); // 页面加载时初始化 window.addEventListener("load", () => { initChart(); fetchData(); });
